mono.subject: 11-assist
mono.title: 参与：辅助科技与日常动作

phrase.zh: 好的工具，让更多人参与。
phrase.en: Good tools make room for more people.

visual.zh: 相触的手与机械部件把辅助科技放回日常动作中，强调参与和自主。画面是概念插画，不展示一种获准使用的医疗器械，也不承诺具体康复效果。
visual.en: Hands and mechanical parts place assistive technology within everyday action, emphasizing participation and autonomy. This is a concept illustration, not an approved medical device or a promise of rehabilitation outcomes.

background.zh: 世界卫生组织与联合国儿童基金会的 2022 年报告估计，全球超过 25 亿人需要一种或多种辅助产品，例如轮椅、助听器或支持沟通的应用。这个数字是该报告的估计，不是本屏保实时统计；辅助科技也远不止机械义肢。
background.en: A 2022 WHO and UNICEF report estimated that more than 2.5 billion people needed one or more assistive products, including wheelchairs, hearing aids and communication apps. This is a dated report estimate, not a live count. Assistive technology extends far beyond robotic prostheses.
